source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In this landing the manual branch calls the configuration test without continuing account creation. The test fills returned settings, shows the review title and success notification for a complete field configuration, preserves existing passwords and reports errors in the same form. Stubbed browser tests directly check both-server inputs, updated field values, visible review state and retry readiness; they do not prove authenticated connectivity or account creation. The later conditional Continue policy is a separate source phase.
title: The first combined Account Hub test refreshes settings and stays in the manual form
